name: Tokyo Disneyland and Tokyo DisneySea park tickets
intro: Tokyo Disneyland and Tokyo DisneySea are two separate theme parks at Tokyo Disney Resort, just east of central Tokyo. Each ticket is for one park on a set date, and weekends and school holidays can sell out.

facts.price: 1-Day Passport from ¥8,900 for adults; the price changes by date
facts.visitLength: A full day for one park
facts.bookAhead: Two months: each day goes on sale at 14:00, two months before

statusNote: Read from the official Tokyo Disney Resort ticket sales page.
howToBuy: Buy on the official Tokyo Disney Resort website or app. The site is in English and takes overseas credit cards.
A new day goes on sale every day at 14:00 Japan time, for the same date two months later. For example, tickets for December 20 go on sale on October 20.
Tickets are for one park on one date, and the price changes by date, so choose Tokyo Disneyland or Tokyo DisneySea before you buy.
Weekends and Japanese school holidays sell out first.
rulesToKnow: If the same date doesn't exist two months earlier (for example April 30), tickets go on sale at 14:00 on the 1st of the next month instead.
Some older guides say tickets are released every Wednesday. That is out of date: the official page now says daily.

soldOut.label: Stay at a Disney hotel: rooms open four months ahead

faq.q: How far ahead can I buy Tokyo Disney tickets?
faq.a: Two months. Tickets go on sale every day at 14:00 Japan time for the same date two months later.

faq.q: Can I buy Tokyo Disney tickets at the gate?
faq.a: Don't count on it. Buy online before you go; popular dates sell out.

sources.quote: Tickets will be sold daily from 2:00 p.m. for admissions on the same date two months later.
tickets will be available from 2:00 p.m. on the first day of the next month.
